newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gehe says has more than 50 pct of Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Gehe says has more than 50 pct of Lloyds.

text.p: German drugs wholesaler Gehe AG said on Monday it now held more than 50 percent of the ordinary shares in British bid target Lloyds Chemist Plc.
"I am now 99 percent sure (that Gehe will succeed in the takeover)," Gehe chief executive Dieter Kaemmerer told Reuters.

Kaemmerer also said Gehe's 1996 sales would be around 21 billion marks, compared to the 19.2 billion marks made in 1995, and that 1997 sales would receive a boost of over 25 percent if the Lloyds takeover was completed.
Turnover in 1997 would reach "at least 25 billion marks" in 1997, he added, putting the sales goal for Lloyds Chemist that year at 2.5 billion marks.

British drugs wholesaler Unichem Plc, which had been competing with Gehe for Lloyds, said earlier on Monday it would not be raising its bid for Lloyds after an earlier offer was last week trumped by Gehe's 684.1 million pound bid.
